payload.reason: The evidence indicates that pre-trained embeddings significantly enhance the performance of sequence tagging models by providing context-sensitive representations that are not captured by task-specific RNNs alone.

claims.text: Removing pre-trained embeddings leads to a significant drop in performance, as shown by a decrease to 88.17 F1, which is below the baseline.
Including LM embeddings improves performance from 90.87% to 91.93% F1, demonstrating their importance in capturing semantic and syntactic roles.
The absence of pre-trained embeddings results in less effective context-sensitive representations, negatively impacting model accuracy.
